item.title: Kamala Harris Reminded of Her Blame for High Gas Prices by Industry Association
item.description: “We’ll keep this factual and review your actual record, not your reboot,” an oil and gas trade group told Kamala Harris, responding to her video blaming President Donald Trump for high gas prices during a time of war. In a video posted to social media during her visit to North Carolina Wednesday, Harris complains that the cost of a tank of gas has increased $15 “since the start of Trump’s war of choice.” In the background is a gas station sign showing a price of $3.97 a gallon.

item.title: ‘We Will Safeguard Our Vital Interests in Any Scenario,’ Netanyahu Says After Talking with Trump
item.description: After speaking with President Donald Trump on Monday, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu announced that his country will do whatever it takes to defend itself, regardless of any agreement the U.S. strikes with the terrorist Iranian regime. Netanyahu detailed his conversation with Trump in a video posted on his X.com account.
